title: Ensure 'Do not preserve zone information in file attachments' is set to 'Disabled'
remediation: Set GP: User Configuration\Policies\Administrative Templates\Windows Components\Attachment Manager\Do not preserve zone information in file attachments to 'Disabled'
reason: A file that is downloaded from a computer in the Internet or Restricted Sites zone may be moved to a location that makes it appear safe, like an intranet file share, and executed by an unsuspecting user.

title: Ensure 'Notify antivirus programs when opening attachments' is set to 'Enabled'
remediation: Set GP: User Configuration\Policies\Administrative Templates\Windows Components\Attachment Manager\Notify antivirus programs when opening attachments to 'Enabled'
reason: Antivirus programs that do not perform on-access checks may not be able to scan downloaded files.
